title: chat-server: MemoryBackend Message ids are uuid v4, not ULIDs
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L591: 'Message IDs are ULIDs, assigned by the receiving mailbox at storage time. ULIDs are lexicographically ordered by time'. MemoryBackend::create_object (memory.rs ~L758) assigns uuid::Uuid::new_v4() to every type, so id order is random. Chat.unreadCount (L548, JMAP-y3f2.4) and unreadReplyCount (L642, computed in message.rs fill_reply_counts since JMAP-y3f2.3) both compare ids lexicographically, so on MemoryBackend they are only correct for seeded ULID ids. Fix: assign ULIDs to Message (and Chat, L489) in MemoryBackend. Found while implementing JMAP-y3f2.3.
